children: Japanese stocks may decline as concerns about the Iran war and higher energy costs resurface. Nikkei futures are down 0.8% at 65905 on the SGX. The dollar is at 159.79 yen, compared with Y159.86 as of Monday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are focusing on developments in the Middle East and crude oil prices. The Nikkei Stock Average fell 0.1% to 66311.93 on Monday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com)
